title: igiveyouarendezvous problem
description: Everything to plan: recruiters, candidates with the recruiters they must meet, availabilities and settings. Read in YAML or JSON.

from.description: First day of the period to plan (the command may give another one).

to.description: Last day of the period to plan, included (from by default).

not-before.description: To plan again in the middle of the period: the first date of new interviews; the fixed interviews of the -start plan may come before.

weekdays.description: The days of the week with interviews (Monday to Friday by default).

closed.description: Dates without interviews, such as holidays.

day.description: Default availability of everybody, every day (08:00-12:00 by default).

breaks.description: Times without interviews, every day, such as lunch; two interviews of a candidate on a same day never lie on both sides of a break. The longest break separates the morning from the afternoon.

step.description: Time grid: interviews start on multiples of it (automatic by default).

min-gap.description: The least time between two interviews of a candidate (0 by default).

max-gap.description: The most time between two interviews of a candidate: 0 (the default) chains the interviews; "unlimited" removes the limit.

recruiter-min-gap.description: The gap of every recruiter without a min-gap of their own: the shortest time between two of their interviews, nights included (10m, 30m). By default, none.

joint-groups.description: Groups of recruiters who may interview a candidate together (allowed, not required).

panels.description: Recruiters who always interview together, such as a jury. A list of groups: a candidate meets the members of a group they need at once, with nobody else, and a recruiter is in one group at most, and then in no joint group. Or panels by name, each with its members, when it sits and where: a candidate meets one by naming it in meet, possibly as one of a choice, and a recruiter may sit on several.

max-joint-size.description: Maximum recruiters in a joint interview (0: no limit).

rooms.description: Interviews that can be held at the same time, whoever attends them: the rooms, tables or booths there are. 0 means no limit.

break-spread.description: How far the recruiters' numbers of breaks may differ, counting those with at least two interviews. Absent means no limit; 0 asks every recruiter to wait exactly as often as every other.

precedences.description: Candidates to hold in order: each entry is a pair of candidate names, the first over before the second begins.

objectives.description: The objectives, most important first (see igiveyouarendezvous -list-objectives).

recruiters.description: The recruiters, by name; a recruiter without settings takes the defaults.

duration.description: Length of an interview with this recruiter; a joint interview lasts as long as its longest part.

min-gap.description: The shortest time between two interviews of the recruiter, from the end of one to the start of the next, nights included: to write notes, to pack the gear (30m, 1h); the journeys between places come on top (see travel). 0 means none. In place of recruiter-min-gap.

continuous.description: For a guest (optional: true somewhere): once away from a visit of the day, away for the rest of it, rather than coming back to a later one. Without it, coming back is only avoided, between schedules as good on every objective.

meet.description: The recruiters to meet: a list, in any order, or the recruiters with their ranks (1 first, then 2..., X any time), the length of the meeting (15m, 1h30: a bare number is a rank), or both: {rank: 1, duration: 15m}. One recruiter among several is a list within the list, [Manager, [Ada, Ben, Cleo]], or the same choice in the mapping: {Ada: {choice: assessor}, Ben: {choice: assessor}}.

optional.description: Invites the recruiter without needing them (false by default): the candidate is complete without this meeting, and holding it is a bonus the search looks for. The guest who comes along if they can — a friend on an outing, a second assessor if they are free. The meeting is held with the guests who are free at that time and without the others, and is never given up for a guest. Guests are invited for the sake of the objective "meetings": keep it among the objectives, before those on the recruiters' time.

choice.description: Names a choice: the candidate meets one of the recruiters with the same choice, whoever suits the schedule. They share their rank and optional.

place.description: For one of a choice: where the candidate is met when this recruiter is the one chosen, in place of the candidate's place, for the journeys before and after (lunch at the bistro in the old town or at the market).

meetings.description: Meetings with several recruiters at once, each held as given, with nobody else: a candidate may meet a recruiter in several of them, such as {with: [Host, Camera], duration: 1h, times: 5}. Each lasts its duration, or else the candidate's, or else the default.

with.description: The recruiters met at once; a list within it is one of them: [Host, [Camera 1, Camera 2]].

times.description: How many such meetings, 1 by default.

priority.description: One candidate outranks any number of candidates of lower priority (1 by default).

duration.description: Length of the interviews of this candidate, in place of the recruiters' ones (the length of a meeting, for instance).

together.description: A meeting: all the recruiters at once, in one interview, whatever the joint groups, or not at all (false by default). No ranks in meet then.

place.description: Where the candidate is met, such as the city of a shoot: a recruiter needs the journey (see travel) between two interviews at different places. None by default: no journey to or from them, such as a call.

required.description: A constraint and no longer an objective: the program refuses to return a schedule without this candidate, and names them instead (false by default). For what the day is built around and carries no interest of its own: the train that was booked, the keys handed back at the hotel. A priority ranks what one would rather have; this says there is nothing to rank.

travel.description: The journeys between the places of the candidates, upper estimates: a recruiter needs the journey, on top of their min-gap, between two interviews at different places, nights included. A journey through other places counts when shorter.

default.description: The journey between two places that journeys does not list. Without it, every two places of the candidates must be listed.

journeys.description: The time between two places, both ways: [Paris, Lyon, 2h].

spans.description: Time spans, such as "08:00-12:00, 14:00-17:00" (or 8h-12h), or a list of spans; "none": never.

duration.description: A length of time: 45m, 1h, 1h30, 1h30m, or a number of minutes.

gap.description: A time between two interviews: a duration (0, 30m, 1h30, a number of minutes) or a number of calendar days (3d, 3 days).

availability.description: When the person is available: time spans valid every day, or time spans by date (absent on the other dates).

choice.description: One recruiter among several: the candidate meets one of them, whoever suits the schedule.
